get.summary: Get the business details for the connected user, e.g. business name, type, address, year end date, vat status and account size statistics.
Query bank account transactions by date range, nominal code, reference or amount

parameters.name: order_column
parameters.description: Which columns should be used for ordering the record set. E.g. date, amount.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Search by whole or partial reference

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Search by whole or partial notes.

parameters.name: amount_from
parameters.description: Amount range from (use - prefix for debits)

parameters.name: amount_to
parameters.description: Amount range to (use - prefix for debits)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of transaction, e.g. (credit) or (debit). Leave absent for both.

parameters.name: tag_status
parameters.description: Tag status of the bank transaction, e.g. tagged or untagged

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page offset. Zero (0) would show results from the beginning of the record set. Offset can be used for paging functions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records would you like the API to return.

get.summary: Retreives a chart of nominal accounts

parameters.name: nominal_code_start
parameters.description: The nominal code range from where you would like to start. Default is 1

parameters.name: nominal_code_end
parameters.description: The nominal code range to where you would like to end. Default is 9999

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: From date. If excluded returns all transactions from beginning of time.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: To date. If excluded returns all transactions to the current date.

parameters.name: exclude_zero_balance_ledgers
parameters.description: Excludes any ledgers that hold a zero balance for the given date range. If excluded will assume to be true.

amount.description: For "money out" transactions enter as a negative value.

type.description: Account type. E.g. current, petty, buildingsoc, loan, merchant, creditcard, reserve

name.description: A name for this bank account

currency.description: Currency Code (Default is GBP). Specifiy an alternative currency only if you have enabled multi-currency accounting.

account_number.description: A bank account number if applicable

dashboard_pinned.description: Show the account balance on the dashboard for this account. Default is false.

date.description: The date the opening balance should be committed

default_currency.description: If not supply will revert to account default.
